description: One worry about ACE is that it simply copies the source clip. For every query this file records whether the output sits closer to its own source clip or to the nearest real clip of the target skeleton, measured in four simple movement features. Most outputs are closer to a target clip, so copying does not explain the score.

ACE-I.features: how far the centre of mass travels, how much it varies, mean velocity, and how often the feet touch the ground

ACE-T.features: how far the centre of mass travels, how much it varies, mean velocity, and how often the feet touch the ground
